hero.subtitle: Record security-relevant actions with Cloudflare-aware IP/port, success/failure, and optional actor userId — then query them as SUPER via GET /audit.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: The module under src/common/audit is CQRS-ready (Postgres active, Mongo standby). Annotate HTTP handlers with @Audit(); an interceptor writes a row after success or failure without changing the handler outcome.
items: IP prefers CF-Connecting-IP; port prefers X-Forwarded-Port (Cloudflare-ready)
JWT-authenticated requests auto-fill userId from req.user.id
description — human-readable summary configured on the decorator
Optional identifierFrom / userIdFrom / provider map body or response fields
OAuth provider callbacks use action auth.oauth.callback with a per-provider description
SUPER reads events via GET /api/v1/audit with cursor pagination and q search

decorator.title: Using @Audit for new events
decorator.description: Import AuditModule in the Nest module that owns the controller, then decorate the route handler.
options: action (required) — stable name, e.g. auth.login or billing.refund
description — human-readable summary stored on the event
identifierFrom — body path(s) for email/username (string or string[])
userIdFrom — response path for user id on success (e.g. user.id)
provider / providerFrom — static or body path provider label

userid.title: Authenticated userId
userid.description: When the request has a JWT user (req.user.id), that id is stored on both success and failure. If userIdFrom resolves on a successful response, that value wins.

api.title: SUPER list API
api.description: Read-only. Requires Authorization: Bearer and Role.SUPER.
endpoints: Query: cursor, limit (1–100, default 50), q, ip, success, action, category, userId, provider
